title: Corrective fix for B-00f4e37d: Review ingredient aggregation delivery
description:
Blocked reason: Three findings block sign-off: (1) Medium — spec explicitly requires a text+numeric mixed quantity test ("Text quantity does not merge. [a splash olive oil] + [10 ml olive oil] → quantities: [text 'a splash', 10 ml]"); the existing textQuantitiesAreAppendedAsSeparateEntries test covers only text+text. (2) Low — spec explicitly requires a quantity-less + quantitied mixed test ("@salt{} in Recipe A, @salt{1%tsp} in Recipe B → one item 'salt' with quantities: [1 tsp]"); no such test exists. (3) Low — all three result value types use `public var` instead of the spec's `public let`, adding unintended post-construction mutability to the public API.

Remaining work: Developer must add the two missing test cases and consider aligning property accessors to the spec's `let` contract.
acceptance_criteria: Implement the minimum fix required to unblock B-00f4e37d.
Update tests/docs as needed for the corrective change.
Leave a handoff summary that states how the parent bead can be retried.

handoff_summary.completed: All three findings addressed: public let accessor alignment, text+numeric mixed quantity test, and quantity-less+quantitied mixed test. Swift build confirms no compilation errors.
handoff_summary.remaining: None — all corrective items are implemented. B-00f4e37d can now be retried by running the tester agent against the parent bead.
handoff_summary.risks: No risks. Changes are purely additive (two new tests) plus a narrowing API change (var→let) that the existing call sites already satisfy since the aggregator constructs all result values through their init methods and never mutates them post-construction.
handoff_summary.next_action: Retry B-00f4e37d through the tester agent. The two previously missing test cases now exist and the public API contracts match the spec. The tester should run swift test targeting AggregationTests and verify all cases pass.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — only AggregationTests.swift and Aggregation.swift were modified; no other in-flight bead touches these files.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Changed public var to public let in all three result value types (AggregatedShoppingList, AggregatedAisle, AggregatedItem). This is safe because the aggregator constructs all results through designated initializers and never mutates them after construction. The two new tests follow the exact spec examples verbatim.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Two new test cases added: textAndNumericQuantitiesArePreservedSeparately (text+numeric mixed per spec) and quantityLessOccurrenceMixedWithQuantitiedOccurrenceProducesOneItem (quantity-less+quantitied per spec). Total test count increases from 13 to 15.

conflict_risks: None — only AggregationTests.swift and Aggregation.swift were modified; no other in-flight bead touches these files.

execution_history.summary: Resolved all three blocking findings from the B-00f4e37d review: (1) added textAndNumericQuantitiesArePreservedSeparately test covering text+numeric mixed quantity case, (2) added quantityLessOccurrenceMixedWithQuantitiedOccurrenceProducesOneItem test covering quantity-less+quantitied mixed case, (3) changed all five public var properties in AggregatedShoppingList/AggregatedAisle/AggregatedItem to public let per the spec contract. Build passes cleanly.
